title: swarm: CI-NET fix — the header-block fixtures spell base-repo with example.com, not github.com
body:
CI-NET refused internal/swarm/lintheaderkeys_test.go lines 37 and 89 for a
literal github.com host. Both are the base-repo: value of a card-header
fixture, used only as text, never dialed. cmd/nova-pulse/cut_validated_test.go
and cmd/nova-pulse/fleet_verbs_test.go already spell fixture repo URLs on
example.com, so the two base-repo lines here now follow the same convention:
https://example.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools.git.

go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... are green for the whole
module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
